funktionen.doc_plan_move_joint:
This method takes the following arguments/keyword arguments:

    :param target_joint: List of joint configurations. (type: List of Joint Values - float, units: radians, required: Yes)
    :type target_joint: list
    :param speed: Angular Speed. (units: % of maximum angular speed, default_value: 0.25, required: No)
    :type speed: float
    :param acceleration: Angular Acceleration. (units: % of maximum angular acceleration, default_value: 0.25, required: No)
    :type acceleration: float
    :param current_joint_angles: Current Robot Joint Configuration. (type: List of Joint Values - float, units: radians, default_value: Joint Configuration obtained from Robot Status method, required: No)
    :type current_joint_angles: list
    :param enable_safety: Safety toggle. (units: N/A, default_value: value of the safety toggle in Program screen if not set, required: No)

        - True, Max speed is slashed to 25%
        - False, No reduction in already set max speed
    :type enable_safety: bool
    :param enable_blending: Allows to switch between blending and non blending mode. (units: N/A, default_value: False, required: No)

        - True : Joint Motion does not stop at every point
        - False : Joint Motion stops at every point.
    :type enable_blending: bool
    :param store_id: identifier to the stored plan. (if not provided a random will be assigned, which will be returned after the function execution)
    :type store_id: int
    :param reusable: to reuse the identifier for repeated motion. (default_value: False )
    :type reusable: bool

    :param controller_parameters: Dictionary defining the control mode and force/torque vectors.
    :type controller_parameters: Dict[str, Any]

    :param controller_parameters["control_mode"]: Control mode used to execute the motion. Options include:
        - "position": Position control mode.
        - "joint_impedance": Joint impedance control mode.
        - "hybrid": Hybrid Motion/Force control mode.
        - "admittance": Admittance control mode.
    :type controller_parameters["control_mode"]: str

    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]: Dictionary containing Cartesian force control settings.
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]

    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fx"]: Force control setting in the X direction.
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fx"]: Dict[str, Any]
    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fx"]["is_active"]: Whether force control is active for the X direction.
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fx"]["is_active"]: bool
    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fx"]["value"]: Desired force value in Newtons (N).
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fx"]["value"]: float

    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fy"]: Force control setting in the Y direction.
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fy"]: Dict[str, Any]
    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fy"]["is_active"]: Whether force control is active for the Y direction.
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fy"]["is_active"]: bool
    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fy"]["value"]: Desired force value in Newtons (N).
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fy"]["value"]: float

    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fz"]: Force control setting in the Z direction.
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fz"]: Dict[str, Any]
    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fz"]["is_active"]: Whether force control is active for the Z direction.
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fz"]["is_active"]: bool
    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fz"]["value"]: Desired force value in Newtons (N).
    :type controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fz"]["value"]: float

    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]: Dictionary containing Cartesian torque control settings.
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]

    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]: Torque control setting around the X-axis.
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]: Dict[str, Any]
    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]["is_active"]: Whether torque control is active for the X-axis.
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]["is_active"]: bool
    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]["value"]: Desired torque value in Newton-meters (Nm).
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]["value"]: float

    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["My"]: Torque control setting around the Y-axis.
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["My"]: Dict[str, Any]
    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["My"]["is_active"]: Whether torque control is active for the Y-axis.
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["My"]["is_active"]: bool
    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["My"]["value"]: Desired torque value in Newton-meters (Nm).
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["My"]["value"]: float

    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mz"]: Torque control setting around the Z-axis.
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mz"]: Dict[str, Any]
    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mz"]["is_active"]: Whether torque control is active for the Z-axis.
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mz"]["is_active"]: bool
    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mz"]["value"]: Desired torque value in Newton-meters (Nm).
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mz"]["value"]: float
    
    :return: plan_id (equal to store_id if provided in inputs, else an identifier function has generated to store the plan)

                            0.10337461241185522
                        ],
                        [
                            2.1372059994827075,

                            -1.8651270179353125,
                            0.044771940725327274,
                            -1.173860821592129,
                            0.10315646291502645
                        ],
                        [
                            1.9180047887810003,
                            -0.24855170101601043,
                            -1.3680228668892351,
                            0.12404421791100637,
                            -1.1914147150222498,

                        ]
                    ],
                    "store_id":234,

funktionen.doc_executor:
Execute already planned motion IDs.

    This method allows you to execute a list of planned motion IDs, which represent pre-defined motion sequences or plans. This needs to be used in conjuction with plan_move_ciruclar/joint/linear/composite/record_path functions.

    Args:
        List of Int: List of planned motion IDs to be executed.

    **Sample Usage:**

        .. code-block:: python

            from neurapy.robot import Robot
            r = Robot()
            planned_motion_ids = r.plan_move_joint([0]*r.dof)  # Replace with your planned motion IDs
            r.executor([planned_motion_ids])
funktionen.doc_wait_motion_finished:
This method allows to wait for a motion to complete. 
    If there is no motion queued or all motions are already done this motion, checks once and skips waiting.
    Note that this only is effective if the motion is called with the non blocking option.
    

    **Sample Usage:**

        .. code-block:: python

            from neurapy.robot import Robot
            r = Robot()

            joint_command = {
            "speed": 10,
            "acceleration": 10,
            "jerk": 100,
            "blocking": False,
            "target_joint": [
                r.get_current_joint_angles(),
                [0.0] * 6
            ]
            "current_joint_angles": r.get_current_joint_angles()
            }

            r.move_joint(**joint_command) # Does not block until motion is completed
            r.wait_motion_finished() # waits till motion is done
funktionen.doc_motion_status:

        - 'NOT_RUNNING': If the robot is not running.

funktionen.doc_movelinear_online:
Method to do Servo in Cartesian Space
    
    :param servo_target_position: List of Cartesian target positions in meters. Length should be 7, containing [X, Y, Z, qw, qx, qy, qz].
    :type servo_target_position: list[float]

    :param servo_target_velocity: List of maximum Cartesian velocities in meters per second. Length should be 6, containing [x_dot, y_dot, z_dot, omega_x, omega_y, omega_z].
    :type servo_target_velocity: list[float]

    :param servo_target_acceleration: List of maximum Cartesian accelerations in meters per second squared. Length should be 6, containing [x_ddot, y_ddot, z_ddot, alpha_x, alpha_y, alpha_z].
    :type servo_target_acceleration: list[float]

    :return: Servo warning and error codes.
    :rtype: int

    **Sample Usage:**
    
        .. code-block:: python

            from neurapy.robot import Robot
            import time
            import copy

            r = Robot()

            target_1 = 0.3
            target_2 = 0.25

            #Switch to external servo mode
            r.activate_servo_interface('position')
            cart_pose_length = 7 # X,Y,Z,qw,qx,qy,qz
            target = copy.deepcopy(r.get_current_cartesian_pose())
            print(target)

            # Move target_1 unit in -X direction
            target[0] -= target_1
            velocity = [0.15]*6 
            acceleration = [2.]*6
            error_code = r.movelinear_online(target, velocity, acceleration)

            #Sleep for 5 sec to complete the motion.
            time.sleep(5)

            target = copy.deepcopy(r.get_current_cartesian_pose())
            #Move target_2 units in +Z direction
            target[2] += target_2
            error_code = r.movelinear_online(target, velocity, acceleration)

            #Sleep for 5 sec to complete the motion
            time.sleep(5)

            print("Robot stopped")
            r.deactivate_servo_interface()
            r.stop()
funktionen.doc_stop_movelinear_online:
Method to stop MoveLinearOnline motion if running

    **Sample Usage**
    
        .. code-block:: python

            from neurapy.robot import Robot
            import time
            import copy

            r = Robot()

            target_1 = 0.3
            target_2 = 0.25

            #Switch to external servo mode
            r.activate_servo_interface('position')
            cart_pose_length = 7 # X,Y,Z,qw,qx,qy,qz
            target = copy.deepcopy(r.get_current_cartesian_pose())
            print(target)

            # Move target_1 unit in -X direction
            target[0] -= target_1
            velocity = [0.15]*6 
            acceleration = [2.]*6
            error_code = r.movelinear_online(target, velocity, acceleration)

            #Sleep for 5 sec to complete the motion.
            time.sleep(5)

            target = copy.deepcopy(r.get_current_cartesian_pose())
            #Move target_2 units in +Z direction
            target[2] += target_2
            error_code = r.movelinear_online(target, velocity, acceleration)

            #Sleep for 2 sec to complete the motion
            time.sleep(2)

            #Stop the movelinear online motion
            r.stop_movelinear_online()
            time.sleep(3)
            print("Robot stopped")
            r.deactivate_servo_interface()
            r.stop()
funktionen.doc_servo_x:
Method to do Servo in Cartesian Space
    
    :param servo_target_position: List of Cartesian target positions in meters. Length of list should be 7, containing [X, Y, Z, qw, qx, qy, qz].
    :type servo_target_position: list[float]

    :param servo_target_velocity: List of Cartesian target velocities in meters per second and radians per second. The first three elements represent translational velocity (m/s), and the next three elements represent rotational velocity (rad/s).
    :type servo_target_velocity: list[float]

    :param servo_target_acceleration: List of Cartesian target accelerations in meters per second squared and radians per second squared. The first three elements represent translational acceleration (m/s²), and the next three elements represent rotational acceleration (rad/s²).
    :type servo_target_acceleration: list[float]

    :param gain_parameter: ServoX gain parameter used for the proportional controller; should be within the range [0.2, 100].
    :type gain_parameter: float

    :return: Servo warning and error codes.
    :rtype: int


    **Sample Usage:**
    
        .. code-block:: python

            from neurapy.robot import Robot
            import time
            from ruckig import InputParameter, OutputParameter, Result, Ruckig
            import copy

            r = Robot()

            #Switch to external servo mode
            r.activate_servo_interface('position')

            cart_pose_length = 7 #X,Y,Z,qw,qx,qy,qz

            otg = Ruckig(cart_pose_length, 0.001)  # control cycle
            inp = InputParameter(cart_pose_length)
            out = OutputParameter(cart_pose_length)

            inp.current_position = r.get_current_cartesian_pose()
            inp.current_velocity = [0.]*cart_pose_length
            inp.current_acceleration = [0.]*cart_pose_length

            target = copy.deepcopy(inp.current_position)
            target[0] += 0.2 # Move 200mm in X direction
            inp.target_position = target
            inp.target_velocity = [0.]*cart_pose_length
            inp.target_acceleration = [0.]*cart_pose_length

            inp.max_velocity = [0.5]*cart_pose_length
            inp.max_acceleration = [3]*cart_pose_length
            inp.max_jerk = [10.]*cart_pose_length
            res = Result.Working

            servox_proportional_gain = 25

            velocity = [0.] * 6 #Since ruckig does not provide rotational velocity if quaternion is input, we can send 0 rotational feedforward velocity
            acceleration = [0.] * 6 #Since ruckig does not provide rotational acceleration if quaternion is input, we can send 0 rotational feedforward acceleration

            while res == Result.Working:
                '''
                Error code is returned through Servo. 
                '''
                error_code = 0
                if(error_code < 3):

                    res = otg.update(inp, out)

                    position = out.new_position

                    for i in range(0,3): # Updating target translation velocity and accelerations
                        velocity[i] = out.new_velocity[i]
                        acceleration[i] = out.new_acceleration[i]
                    
                    error_code = r.servo_x(position, velocity, acceleration, servox_proportional_gain)
                    scaling_factor = r.get_servo_trajectory_scaling_factor()
                    out.pass_to_input(inp)
                    time.sleep(0.001)
                else:
                    print("Servo in error, error code, ", error_code)
                    break
            r.deactivate_servo_interface()

            r.stop()
funktionen.doc_move_joint:
To move the robot to specified joint configuration in joint space. 

    :param target_joint: List of joint configurations (type: List of Joint Values - float or int, units: radians, required: Yes) Alternative: (List of) String (type: String, name of existing point)
    :type target_joint: list
    :param speed: Angular Speed. (units: % of maximum angular speed, default_value: 0.25, required: No)
    :type speed: float
    :param acceleration: Angular Acceleration. (units: % of maximum angular acceleration, default_value: 0.25, required: No)
    :type acceleration: float
    :param current_joint_angles: Current Robot Joint Configuration. (type: List of Joint Values - float, units: radians, default_value: Joint Configuration obtained from Robot Status method, required: No)

    :param enable_blending: Allows to switch between blending and non blending mode. (units: N/A, default_value: False, required: No)

    :param controller_parameters["force_vector"]["Fz"]["value"]: Desired force value in Newtons (N).

    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]: Dictionary containing Cartesian torque control settings.

    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]: Torque control setting around the X-axis.
    :type controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]: Dict[str, Any]
    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]["is_active"]: Whether torque control is active for the X-axis.

    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["Mx"]["value"]: Desired torque value in Newton-meters (Nm).

    :param controller_parameters["torque_vector"]["My"]: Torque control setting around the Y-axis.
